title: Explicit all-dimension remainder bounds for matrix Bingham normalization with symmetric parameters and sub-square-root Frobenius growth
author: Armine Bagyan; Donald Richards
work: Complete Asymptotic Expansions for the Normalizing Constants of High-Dimensional Matrix Bingham and Matrix Langevin Distributions
source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) article 094, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2024.094; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof controls a matrix hypergeometric tail through zonal-polynomial integrals over the orthogonal group, combining principal-minor bounds with marginal Haar moments. Partition-wise shifted-factorial estimates then give constants uniform across the summation, and a telescoping factorial-tail argument produces the explicit closed exponential bound. Both the series and closed-form estimates belong to one proof unit for d at least p at least one and Frobenius growth exponent 0 <= r < 1.
